english.title: Registration plate - carry device / object etc for unlawful activity
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), supplied a person, namely **(..SPECIFY THE PERSON..), who was carrying on business which consisted wholly or partly in the unlawful sale of registration plates, with

(A)_[a plate]_
(B)_[a device, namely **(..SPECIFY THE DEVICE..),]_
(C)_[an object, namely **(..SPECIFY THE OBJECT..),]_

which was not a registration plate, and which you knew or reasonably suspected would be used for the purposes of unlawful activities by **(..SPECIFY..)
english.legislation: Contrary to section 28(2) and (3) of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001.

english.notes:
(i) Proceedings under this Section instituted by a person or body other than a local authority or a constable must have the permission of the Attorney General.
(ii) See section 20(2) for alternative/additional penalty.
(iii) "Registered" means registered in accordance with the provisions of Part 2 of the Vehicles (Crime) Act 2001 in a register established and maintained by the Secretary of State.
(iv) See section 31(1) for other interpretations of Part 2 of the Act.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: A fine not exceeding level four on the standard scale.

NOTE:
Where a registered person is convicted of this offence the court may, instead of or in addition to imposing a fine, by order suspend his registration for any period of up to five years. (section 20(2)).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
